g.text: All four pairs and all 16 exploratory intervals are shown; negative length means a shorter evidence pack.
Chosen after parent means were visible. 10,000 shared family bootstrap draws; no multiplicity correction.
The two raw-score rules have identical payloads and answers on every question; they are not independent replications.
Actual lengths differ. These observations do not establish a length-independent effect or held-out confirmation.
